items.reader: The document recommends not shipping Ranker v7. The lift in Successful Search Rate is real but small, +0.00128 absolute (CI [+0.00054, +0.00202]), and it is well short of the pre-registered +0.005 bar. Guardrails pass, and the test was valid. Current state: the test is complete and the readout is written. Don't ship v7 under the pre-registered bar. Shipping it would be a deliberate exception that the test does not support. The document implies a follow-up check on the navigational-query CTR hypothesis, but it doesn't say who owns that or when it happens (unclear). Successful Search Rate lift, +0.00128 absolute (a change in a rate, 0.4120 → 0.4133), against a bar of +0.005 absolute. The point estimate is about 26% of the bar. The effect is too small to meet the bar, and the CI's upper end (+0.00202) also falls below it, so a longer run won't change the outcome. Secondary risk: about 50 exploratory metrics were tested without correction, so the one nominal hit (navigational CTR, p=0.023) could be chance. Revenue per User is the closest guardrail, with a worst case of about −0.8% against a 1% margin.
